name: Garware Technical Fibres Ltd
about: Established in 1976, Garware-Wall Ropes (GWRL) is one of India's leading players in the technical textiles sector, providing specialized solutions to the cordage and infrastructure industry worldwide. The company manufactures and provides world class solutions in high performance polymer ropes, fishing nets, sports nets, safety nets, aquaculture cages, coated fabrics, agricultural netting and geosynthetics.
keyPoints:
Market Position
The company is among the Top 50 companies and in the Top 25 Technical Textile Manufacturing companies in India as per GPTW. [1]

cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 10.1% over past five years.
